body:
Dear colleagues,

Following approval by the Management Committee, please note the updated parental leave policy (v3.0), effective 2025-01-01.

Parental leave is 16 weeks fully paid for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks fully paid for the secondary caregiver. Eligibility requires at least 6 months of service on the start date of the leave.

The full policy is available on the HR SharePoint (HR Policies > Current Policies). This replaces all previous versions.

Kind regards,
Wim Goossens
Head of HR
Vandenberg Logistics NV
